title: Performance, Reliability & Failure-Injection Testing
why_no_brittle_latency_assertion: this project already has one known-flaky CPU-timer-dependent test (test_detector_benchmark.py, documented since P6.2, observed both passing and failing across different runs this session); adding another timing threshold would repeat exactly the mistake this phase's own brief warns against; the one place duration matters (Fabric timeout test) asserts on outcome (exception type) with a threshold an order of magnitude below the injected delay, never on measured wall-clock duration

ocr_barcode_failure.what_it_proves: a backend/reader that raises mid-call returns a clean 500 standard envelope, no leaked exception text, verified against the real POST /ocr/extract route
ocr_barcode_failure.discovery: app.dependency_overrides could not intercept get_ocr_backend/get_barcode_reader individually since get_ocr_service calls them as plain functions, not Depends params — had to override get_ocr_service itself; found by running the first draft and diagnosing why the override had no effect

concurrency.health_endpoint: 20 real threads, all 200, metrics registry count exactly 20 — no lost updates under its Lock
concurrency.rate_limited_predict: 15 real threads against a limit of 5: exactly 5 succeed, exactly 10 rejected with 429 — no races in the counter under contention
concurrency.self_found_bugs: metrics test needed registry reset between runs (state bleed); rate-limit test needed a directly-shared RateLimiter instance, same lesson as P7.4's own override-lambda bug

fabric_timeout.what_it_proves: client's own fabric_timeout_seconds is actually enforced against a reachable-but-slow peer (new evaluate_delay_seconds field on FakeGatewayBehavior, default 0.0, zero behavior change to existing tests), distinct from the already-covered port-closed unavailable case
fabric_timeout.result: raises FabricUnavailable via genuine grpc.StatusCode.DEADLINE_EXCEEDED with a 0.5s client timeout against a 2.0s server delay

tests.mypy_new_code: 0 errors — added cast(FastAPI, client.app) helper for upstream stub imprecision

security_considerations: OCR/barcode failure tests re-verify under a genuine failure (not just source-reading) that exception internals never leak to a client
no new network-facing attack surface added
